items.stem: How does a realtime voice interaction differ from a standard text request and response?

options.text: It streams audio continuously and handles events during the turn, not just one request and reply
options.rationale: Correct: realtime streams audio and events throughout the turn.

options.text: It always costs less than a text request
options.rationale: Cost is not what distinguishes realtime voice.

options.text: It removes the need for any tools
options.rationale: Voice apps can still call tools mid-conversation.

items.explanation: Correct: realtime streams audio and events throughout the turn.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why should a voice assistant avoid buffering the entire user utterance before responding?

options.text: It adds perceptible delay and makes the conversation feel unnatural
options.rationale: Correct: waiting for the full utterance increases latency.

options.text: It makes the audio format invalid
options.rationale: Buffering does not invalidate the audio format.

options.text: It is required by every voice API
options.rationale: Streaming, not full buffering, is the realtime approach.

items.explanation: Correct: waiting for the full utterance increases latency.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO behaviours should a well-built realtime voice assistant support? (Select TWO)

options.text: Barge-in so the user can interrupt the assistant
options.rationale: Correct: supporting interruptions is core to natural voice.

options.text: A graceful fallback when the audio connection drops
options.rationale: Correct: live calls must handle dropped audio.

options.text: Talking over the user when they try to interrupt
options.rationale: Talking over the user is a failure, not a feature.

options.text: Ignoring connection loss during a call
options.rationale: Ignoring connection loss degrades the experience.

items.explanation: Correct: supporting interruptions is core to natural voice.
